messages:
Maya K: FYI customer 'BrightLayer' opened an escalation — asking to convert to Net60 but finance flagged tax/VAT mismatch and missing PO. They've also had a recent card decline. Need quick path for provisional access, they are blocked in staging.
Oliver Chen: thanks, Maya. Can you paste the invoice metadata and the PO they uploaded? we need to confirm billing entity and VAT ID. Also include the payment provider error if available.
Maya K: pasted below (redacted):
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0045
Amount: $42,500.00
Currency: USD
PO: BL-PO-7890 (uploaded)
BillTo entity: BrightLayer Inc. (VAT: --)
Customer notes: request Net60, referencing previous verbal agreement
Payment attempt: card decline last night -> provider code: card_declined\n```
Maya K: customer says PO was issued to BrightLayer UK but billing entity on account is BrightLayer US. VAT ID in portal is blank.
BillingBot: Auto-note: payment gateway returned `card_declined` (code 402). Retry allowed after 24h. Ticket #BILL-6321 created.
Samir Patel: quick question — do we have a signed SOW or master services agreement? Net60 requests require credit review + either signed contract or AR onboarding.
Maya K: no signed SOW in SFDC, only email threads. They claim enterprise procurement sent PO today.
Oliver Chen: this is two issues: 1) tax/VAT mismatch — we need the VAT registration or correct billing entity; 2) Net terms risk — finance needs credit check. Options: (a) temporary provisional credit for 30 days with usage cap, (b) require upfront for first invoice, (c) ask for guaranteed payment via ACH/wire + Net60 going forward.
Ops-Escalations: for staging access we can enable read-only tokens if finance approves provisional. Need explicit approval string from finance + compliance signoff for VAT missing.
Samir Patel: I'll reach out to customer contacts. Ask them to upload: signed PO matching billing entity, VAT registration (if EU), and a scanned sign SOW or email approval from procurement. I'll try to get a letter of intent for payment schedule.
Maya K: customer replied: procurement insists PO is valid — points to PO BL-PO-7890 (issued to BrightLayer UK Ltd). They said they will cover tax via reverse charge but didn't send VAT ID.
Oliver Chen: reverse charge is OK only if we have VAT ID and correct invoice wording. Without that we can't net out VAT. Finance won't approve Net60 for international entities without docs.
BillingBot: Note: previous invoice attempt 2026-03-05 failed with gateway `card_declined`. No retries since card is expired per token metadata.
Samir Patel: proposal: offer provisional Net30 (not Net60) conditioned on deposit of 25% of first invoice ($10,625) via wire within 48h and upload of VAT docs + signed PO. After receipt, finance will onboard them for Net60 review in 30 days. Thoughts?
Oliver Chen: I support provisional Net30 + deposit. Escalate to Finance for expedited review. Also ask Legal to accept email-authorized SOW for onboarding if signature not possible today.
Maya K: customer accepted provisional Net30 + deposit but asked if we can instead start with a credit hold release so they can unblock staging immediately — they can provide a portal screenshot of wire initiation.
Ops-Escalations: we can release staging for 72h dev access upon proof of wire initiation and internal approval from finance (ops cannot override finance). We'll need a ticket with payment reference.
Samir Patel: I'll collect docs and wire remittance. Action items: 1) Samir to get PO + VAT + wire proof by EOD (2005001290). 2) Oliver to ping Finance for provisional Net30 approval + deposit hold. 3) Ops-Escalations to standby for 72h staging unlock after finance confirms. 4) Maya to confirm card token removal to avoid accidental retries.
Maya K: tagging @Oliver Chen and @Ops-Escalations — please confirm once finance responds so I can update customer. :thumbsup:
Oliver Chen: pinged finance Slack thread with subject "BrightLayer provisional Net30 request". Will update here.
BillingBot: Update: Ticket BILL-6321 -> Payment method flagged expired. Recommend customer supply wire or valid card.
Samir Patel: got email from procurement with scanned PO and a PDF that includes VAT: GB999999999. Uploading to SFDC now. Will send wire remittance once finance gives bank details.
Ops-Escalations: ready to enable staging contingent on finance ok. Please include payment reference and clear timeframe.
Oliver Chen: Finance approved provisional Net30 with 25% deposit hold pending legal quick review. Legal ok with email-authorized SOW for onboarding. Finance note: if VAT documentation is inconsistent after deposit clears, we'll pause further provisioning until corrected.
Maya K: relaying to customer: provisional Net30 accepted with $10,625 deposit wire in 48h, send proof and VAT docs; once verified ops will re-enable staging for 72h. Customer replied :cry: but agreed to proceed.
Samir Patel: closing loop — uploaded PO and VAT, customer sent wire screenshot ref WIRE-4772. I emailed finance receipt.
BillingBot: Payment received (pending reconciliation) — reference WIRE-4772.
Oliver Chen: thanks team. leave this thread open until reconciliation completes and full Net60 review in 30 days.
Maya K: will follow up. marking action items in SFDC task. :white_check_mark:
